messages:
Alison: quick check — final panel for ML Infra candidate on Thurs 3/24 11:00 PT still good? I have the slot reserved but need confirms. @Maya @Samir
Samir: I can do 11:00 PT, prefer 11-11:45
Maya: I’m OOO until 11:15, can join at 11:15. 10:30 also works if others prefer earlier
Alison: ok can shift to 11:15 start if everyone is fine with 45m total (11:15–12:00 PT). @Samir any objections?
Samir: fine with 11:15. Also quick note — I’ll ask the candidate a perf/latency tradeoffs question.
Alison: recruiter-bot, can you update the calendar invite and nudge panelers?
recruiter-bot: Calendar invite updated: Candidate: Jordan Lee — Panel: Alison, Samir, Maya — Start: 11:15 PT — Duration: 45m. Reminder: 30m before.
Samir: Heads-up to panel: please use Rubric v3.2 (link in hiring docs). Main focus: system design + latency cost tradeoffs. I’ll paste a short checklist below.
Samir: ```Rubric v3.2 highlights:
- System design clarity (0-4)
- Tradeoff reasoning (0-4)
- Practical optimizations + measurable impact (0-3)
- Communication & collaboration (0-1)
- Red flags: no testing/benchmarking strategy, ignores cost/ops
```
Alison: can we assign a debrief lead? someone to consolidate scores into Greenhouse and write a 1-paragraph summary
Maya: I’ll take debrief lead — I can consolidate scores and write summary in GH within 24h. Also will capture any follow-ups.
Alison: appreciated. Samir — do you want a specific quantization question or keep it general on latency optimizations?
Samir: general is fine; ask for a before/after example and how they measured perf (latency/throughput) plus any ops tradeoffs. If they mention quantization, follow up on accuracy vs speed.
Alison: noted. One logistics thing — can panelers skim candidate’s recent repo (README + perf tests) before hand? Maya, are you ok flagging 2 files we should read?
Maya: yes — I’ll drop a short pointer in GH: repo link + README + perf_tests/benchmarks.md
recruiter-bot: Reminder set for panelers: 30 minutes before the updated start time.
Samir: LGTM :thumbsup:
Alison: thanks all — I’ll DM candidate logistics and close this thread once invites land.
Alison: (thread closed)
